本实用新型公开了一种生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括箱体，所述箱体底部的四角均固定连接有支撑脚，所述箱体的顶部固定安装有检测箱，所述检测箱的正面通过铰链活动连接有箱门，所述箱门正面的右侧固定安装有门锁。本实用新型通过设置通槽、步进电机、螺纹杆、螺纹块、升降板、复位弹簧、支撑柱、滚轮本体、轴承、滑槽和滑块相互配合，达到了对基因检测设备便于移动的优点，使基因检测设备在因加工流程变动需要进行移动时，能够直接将滚轮伸出，使滚轮支撑起基因检测设备，然后工人直接推动即可，使工人移动基因检测设备时省时省力，减轻了工人的劳动强度，能够满足工人的使用需求。

Gene detection equipment for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a biological genetic engineering technical field specifically is a biological genetic engineering's gene detection equipment.

Background

The gene engineering technology is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, and is a genetic technology which takes molecular genetics as a theoretical basis and takes modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means, constructs hybrid DNA molecules in vitro from genes from different sources according to a pre-designed blueprint, and then introduces the hybrid DNA molecules into living cells to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products, and provides a powerful means for the research of the structure and the function of the genes.

In biological genetic engineering, gene detection equipment is needed, and the existing gene detection equipment has the following defects: the existing gene detection equipment does not have the function of being convenient to move, so that the gene detection equipment needs to be manually carried by a plurality of workers when the gene detection equipment needs to be moved due to the change of a processing flow, the condition that the workers waste time and labor easily occurs is caused, the labor intensity of the workers is increased, and the use requirements of the workers cannot be met.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

The utility model provides a not enough to prior art, the utility model provides a gene detection equipment of biological genetic engineering possesses the advantage of being convenient for to remove gene detection equipment, has solved current gene detection equipment and has not had the function of being convenient for to remove, leads to gene detection equipment when needing to remove because of the processing procedure change, needs the manual transport of many workers, causes the workman to appear the problem that wastes time and energy easily.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a gene detection device for biological gene engineering comprises a box body, wherein four corners of the bottom of the box body are fixedly connected with supporting legs, the top of the box body is fixedly provided with a detection box, the front of the detection box is movably connected with a box door through a hinge, a door lock is fixedly arranged on the right side of the front surface of the box door, through grooves are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the inner wall of the box body, both sides of the top of the inner wall of the box body are fixedly connected with stepping motors, the output ends of the stepping motors are fixedly connected with threaded rods, the surface of the threaded rod is in threaded connection with a threaded block, the inner side of the threaded block is fixedly connected with a lifting plate, the top of the lifting plate is fixedly connected with a return spring, the top of the return spring is fixedly connected with the top of the inner wall of the box body, the four corners of lifter plate bottom are located the equal fixedly connected with support column in top that leads to the groove, there is the gyro wheel body bottom through removable pin swing joint of support column.

Preferably, the front end and the rear end of the two sides of the detection box are fixedly connected with mounting blocks, and the tops of the mounting blocks are fixedly mounted with the top of the box body through bolts.

Preferably, the length of the inner cavity of the through groove is greater than that of the roller body, and the width of the inner cavity of the through groove is greater than that of the roller body.

Preferably, the bottom end of the threaded rod is sleeved with a bearing, and the bottom of the bearing is fixedly connected with the bottom of the inner wall of the box body.

Preferably, the sliding grooves are formed in the two sides of the inner cavity of the box body, the sliding blocks are connected to the inner cavity of the sliding grooves in a sliding mode, and the inner sides of the sliding blocks are fixedly connected with the outer sides of the thread blocks.

(III) advantageous effects

Compared with the prior art, the utility model provides a biological genetic engineering's gene detection equipment possesses following beneficial effect:

1. the utility model discloses a set up logical groove, step motor, the threaded rod, the thread piece, the lifter plate, reset spring, the support column, the gyro wheel body, a bearing, spout and slider mutually support, the advantage of being convenient for to remove gene check out test set has been reached, make gene check out test set when needing to remove because of the processing procedure change, can directly stretch out the gyro wheel, make the gyro wheel prop up gene check out test set, then the workman directly promote can, it is laborsaving to make the workman remove the time-saving when gene check out test set, workman's intensity of labour has been alleviateed, can satisfy workman's user demand.

2. The utility model discloses a set up logical groove, play the effect that conveniently stretches out to support column and gyro wheel body, through setting up reset spring, play the effect that elasticity resets to the lifter plate, through setting up support column and gyro wheel body, play the effect that conveniently supports the removal to the box, through setting up the bearing, stable effect when playing the rotation to the screw rod, through setting up spout and slider, stable effect when playing the removal to the screw thread piece.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is an enlarged view of the cross section of the internal structure of the case body of the present invention;

fig. 3 is a left side view structure diagram of the present invention.

In the figure: 1. a box body; 2. supporting legs; 3. a detection box; 4. a box door; 5. a door lock; 6. a through groove; 7. a stepping motor; 8. a threaded rod; 9. a thread block; 10. a lifting plate; 11. a return spring; 12. a support pillar; 13. a roller body; 14. a bearing; 15. a chute; 16. a slide block.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

All the components of the present invention are general standard components or components known to those skilled in the art, and the structure and principle thereof can be known to those skilled in the art through technical manuals or through routine experimental methods.
